brief: A utensil holder with two bins that is waterproof and dishwasher safe.

requirements.evidence: Two adjacent cells at q0,0,0 and q1,0,0 each fitted with hex-bin-full (bin:0,0,0~hex-bin-full and bin:1,0,0~hex-bin-full) forming two open-top containers for utensils.

Configurator checks fit/collisions only; parts are 3D-printed in user-chosen material with no verified waterproofing, seal, or rating. Solid bins provide enclosed shape but waterproofness cannot be claimed.
Requires material heat/chemical/food-safety verification which configurator does not check. 3D-printed plastic not verified dishwasher safe; cannot be marked met.

finish.summary: Built 2-cell base with two full-depth bins as utensil holder. Waterproof and dishwasher-safe cannot be verified in Hex Cluster (configurator is fit-only, 3D-printed material not rated for water/heat/food safety) so marked unmet.

lines.label: M6 x 25 socket head screw, ISO 4762

notes: Tighten every M6 to 2 N.m: HAND TOOLS ONLY, never a cordless driver. These bolts clamp printed PETG, not metal: at the bolt's own 10.4 N.m rating the head crushes the plastic under it and the joint fails silently, looking tight while holding nothing. Snug, then a nudge. Re-check the bolts after the first few weeks: PETG relaxes under load and the clamp will have eased.
